text:
Situation: Vancomycin hydrochloride is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 277 vials of the 1.25 g presentation (18.2 days) and 412 bags of the 1 g/200 mL presentation (29.7 days). Corvale General holds 338 vials of the 1.25 g presentation (21.3 days) and 447 bags of the 1 g/200 mL presentation (27.6 days). The rule-based best option is to buy from Avenacy, LLC.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows vancomycin hydrochloride is not listed as of 2026-10-21. Hospira posted a discontinuation on 2025-11-14. Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3009864167) received a VAI inspection classification on 2023-06-27.

Our position: Current inventory provides 18 to 30 days of supply across sites and presentations. No active FDA shortage listing exists. The Hospira discontinuation and Gland Pharma inspection history warrant monitoring but do not currently trigger shortage protocols.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Avenacy, LLC; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Baxter Healthcare Corporation as secondary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to qualify BluePoint Laboratories as tertiary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly for status changes; requires no additional approval.
5. Buyer to track Gland Pharma Limited supply continuity given 2023 VAI inspection; requires no additional approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or allocation restrictions at this time.
